nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Config
nodes.rationale: Project keeps a persistent graphify knowledge graph so future codebase/architecture questions are answered from a scoped subgraph instead of re-reading raw files.

nodes.label: Azylis README Overview
nodes.rationale: Static eyewear brand site, no build step or dependencies, documenting Casablanca acetate frame brand.

nodes.label: dev-server.js
nodes.rationale: Must answer HTTP byte-range requests because browsers refuse to seek/stream <video> from a server that ignores Range, so a simpler static server or opening index.html from the filesystem can leave the hero film blank.

nodes.label: i18n.js (README entry)
nodes.rationale: Product names, SKUs, prices and people's names are deliberately left out of the translation map so they pass through untranslated.

nodes.label: Hero Film (#film / heroVideo)
nodes.rationale: currentTime is driven by scroll; the film runs under all three beats and loops on its own, folding from full-bleed hero into a panel beside the clarity copy.

nodes.label: The Reel (#reel six cards)
nodes.rationale: Six cards grow out of a point beside the clarity copy, hold as a stack, then fan across the full width; every position set from script.js.

nodes.label: .fitx-item Blocks
nodes.rationale: Three blocks (Face/Shape, Frame/Width, Temple/Numbers) must be edited in step with the .fitx-step buttons; the script pairs them by index and bails if counts disagree.

nodes.label: Visit the Studio Section
nodes.rationale: Uses store-01.jpg as a lifestyle stand-in for the Casablanca studio; opening hours are invented placeholders per README known gaps.

nodes.label: 50% Off Shelf
nodes.rationale: Shows struck-through card price but the linked product page still shows full price, since the catalogue holds one price per product (per README known gaps).

nodes.label: FAQ Section
nodes.rationale: Delivery windows, refund timings and warranty are invented placeholders per README known gaps.

nodes.label: Site Footer
nodes.rationale: Social links (Instagram, Facebook, X, TikTok) are '#' placeholders per README known gaps.

nodes.label: Shop Grid / Chips Filter
nodes.rationale: Filtered by ?c= category query param (sun-men, sun-women, lenses-men, lenses-women, clip-on).
